summary: Lists reserved special tags: always and never (mostly set on tasks), and tagged, untagged and all (mostly used when selecting).
questions: What special tags does Ansible have?

answer_card.title: Special tags
answer_card.answer_md: Reserved tags: `always`, `never`, `tagged`, `untagged`, `all`. `always` and `never` are mainly set **on tasks**; the other three are used when **selecting** what to run or skip.
